description: Server closes the connection with APPLICATION_CLOSE (0x0e/4014, WIRE.md section 2.8) -- a code ws-mixer itself never emits, only an application via the SDK's close API. The JS client (started with reconnect enabled, same coordination contract as drain_reconnect: the runner passes connect.reconnect={enabled:true} only for this scenario, drain_reconnect, and application_close_client) must treat 4014 as non-fatal and reconnect starting at the backoff cap (WIRE.md section 2.9's Reconnect table: 4014 gets the same start-at-cap treatment as 4009, since an application close is a deliberate, explicit refuse-on-purpose signal, independent of where the attempt counter currently sits). This scenario pins a small reconnect.capMs (and baseMs) via docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 1.1's additive connect.reconnect fields, since a start-at-cap reconnect against the SDK defaults (cap 60000ms) would routinely exceed the runner's fixed 20s per-step timeout. close_reason is deliberately not asserted here: the Go SDK stops reading as soon as it has parsed the error{} message (WIRE.md section 2.7 allows this -- "logs, surfaces and closes"), so it legitimately never observes the close frame that follows and closeReason/close_reason is empty on that path; the human-readable text is in message instead (CLIENT-SDK.md).
